question: When should I use blocking versus non-blocking assignments in SystemVerilog RTL, and what goes wrong if I mix them up?
rubric: Recommends non-blocking (<=) for sequential logic in clocked (always_ff) blocks
Recommends blocking (=) for combinational logic in always_comb blocks
Explains that blocking assignments in sequential logic let later statements see updated values (for example a shift register collapsing)
Mentions simulation races or simulation/synthesis mismatch
Advises against using both kinds of assignment on the same variable
